intended_object: The canonical monoid homomorphism GroupLike_L(L ⊗_k A) → GroupLike_K(K ⊗_k A) for a tower k → L → K and a k-bialgebra A, which extends the scalars of a character along L → K (x ↦ (L→K ⊗ id)(x)). Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the lemma val_groupLikeScalarTowerHom.
explanation: The body has two steps. First, groupLikeBaseChange sends g to 1 ⊗ g in K ⊗_L (L ⊗_k A). Second, the bialgebra isomorphism baseChangeTowerBialgEquiv : K ⊗_L (L ⊗_k A) ≅ K ⊗_k A identifies the target with K ⊗_k A. The lemma val_groupLikeScalarTowerHom, proved in the library, shows that on underlying elements the map is TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k L K) id. That is exactly extension of coefficients from L to K, and it is a monoid hom on group-likes as required. The setting is fully general: arbitrary commutative semirings forming a tower and an arbitrary (not necessarily commutative) k-bialgebra A. None of the splitting, domain or connectedness hypotheses used later in the file are imposed. The shape L ⊗[k] A is intrinsic to the construction. I found no Mathlib declaration giving this tower base-change map on group-like elements.
